# Craft Help Center

## Docs

- [Surround Selection](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/formatting/surround-selection.md): Quickly wrap selected text with parentheses, brackets, or braces.
- [Image Playground](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/image-playground.md): Generate AI images directly in your documents using Apple's Image Playground.
- [Math Formulas](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/math-formulas.md): Write mathematical equations using LaTeX notation — inline within text or as standalone formula blocks.
- [Media](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/media.md): Add and manage images, videos, audio files, and rich media content in your documents.
- [Mermaid Diagrams](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/mermaid-diagrams.md): Use Mermaid to create flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, and other text-based diagrams in Craft.
- [Styling](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/styling.md): Make your documents visually stunning with customizable fonts, colors, backgrounds, and cover images.
- [App Styles](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/styling/app-styles.md): Extend your document's styling to the app interface for a more immersive and cohesive experience.
- [Cards](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/styling/cards.md): Transform pages into visually appealing cards with custom backgrounds, colors, images, and preview styles.
- [Cover Images](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/styling/cover-images.md): Add and customize cover images for your documents with cropping, positioning, and aspect ratio options.
- [Default Page Styles](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/styling/default-styles.md): Set your preferred page style as the default for all new documents.
- [Backdrops, Colors & Separators](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/styling/quick-guide.md): Customize backdrops, document and text colors, fonts, and Washi tape separators, and browse the Styles Gallery for preset looks.
- [Tables](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/tables.md): Create and format tables, use formulas, sort data, and organize information effectively in Craft.
- [Templates](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/templates.md): Use Craft templates to start recurring documents faster, convert existing documents into templates, and keep your own repeatable workflows consistent.
- [Version History](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/version-history.md): Track changes, restore previous versions, and manage document history.
- [Whiteboards](https://craft-support.mintlify.app/en/write-and-edit/whiteboards.md): Create infinite canvas whiteboards for visual thinking, diagramming, and freeform collaboration.
